end.parentNote: Asha practised identifying equal shares and naming halves, thirds, and quarters using roti, drawings, pencils, watermelon, and flags. Nisha explained that one-third means 1 of 3 equal parts and correctly selected equal-part shapes. They also identified 2/5 when 2 of 5 cake pieces were eaten. A parts-versus-parts mix-up was seen once and was not marked corrected after its last appearance; at home, ask Nisha to shade a shape and say the shaded parts out of the total equal parts.
